summary_for_children: Al-Balad means The City. It says Allah showed us two ways and the steep pass is freeing a slave and feeding the hungry and orphans.
environment_concept: A mountain path with two ways and a steep pass climbed by freeing, feeding and caring.

activities.name: Climb the pass
activities.description: Climb by doing acts of kindness (adaptation).
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

status.playable_environment: not built: a shared symbolic setting stands in

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
